bitcoin_core.why: latest tagged release at the time the harness was written; the coin-selection algorithms are used as-is, with only the instrumentation patch in patches/ applied

coin_select.describes: experiment/repair-pass: a local repair pass over the finished selection where ancestry is shared, on top of evanlinjin#5's iterative deepening, evanlinjin#4's flat per-node cost, and PRs #76, #75 and #73
coin_select.why: the ancestor-aware selection work this benchmark exists to measure, with everything the benchmark has since argued for applied: depth-first traversal (#73), per-candidate ancestor sets stored flat rather than as one dense bitset each (#75), a second greedy prefix ordered by (value - own bump) / weight kept whenever the metric scores it better (#76), a per-node cost that no longer grows with the pool (evanlinjin#4), iterative deepening on the bound (evanlinjin#5), and a repair pass that swaps out coins paying for an unconfirmed ancestor alone (experiment/repair-pass). The last three are unmerged drafts, which is the point of pinning them: this matrix is the evidence for them, so it should be run against them. `Changeless` and `LowestFeeChangeless` are still gone with #73, so the harness runs the wallet track alone.
